claim: SALT provides six procedurally generated long-form tasks (logic, math, code, translation, Multi-Needle) with deterministic ground truth, allowing unit-level correctness, calibration and ranking evaluation without judges across 50+ LLMs.
stance_target: L1/L4: zero-noise ground truth and fine-grained units
scope_conditions: 50+ LLMs; code task is Python output prediction of LeetCode functions
quoted_support: SALT comprises six procedurally generated tasks spanning logic, mathematics, code, translation, and multiple-needles-in-a-haystack (Multi-Needle).

breadth.confidence_families: confidence functions over tokens/units (Fig 1, abstract); not hidden-state probes
